newsitem.title: USA: America Online margin seen growing-BARRON'S.
newsitem.headline: America Online margin seen growing-BARRON'S.

text.p: One money manager expects Americ Online Inc's operating margin to grow to 20 percent of revenues of $5 billion in four years, according to Barron's.

In the financial weekly, William Miller, manager of the Legg Mason Value fund, also said he expects pre-tax profit to reach at least 20 percent of revenues over the next five years, with the pre-tax margin reaching "probably 30 percent and maybe 50 percent."
Miller said that with top line growth above 20 percent and multiple of about 30 times earnings, AOL stock could triple in four years.
According to First Call, the consensus estimate for AOL's 1997 earnings per share is a $0.29 loss, compared to a $0.51 profit in 1996.
